children: Pharmaceutical company CSL's bull at Morgan Stanley raises its price target by 9.9% to A$200.00/share after factoring in the benefits of recent partnerships aimed at bolstering its pipeline of new treatments. CSL has announced partnerships with VarmX and Alentis over the past year or so. MS says its price target now includes A$8.00/share for VarmX's VMX-C001 drug candidate and A$3.00/share of Alentis's lixudebart treatment. "On balance, we see these transactions as consistent with CSL management's revised R&D strategy, including the development of candidates from external sources relevant to existing therapeutic areas," analyst David L. Bailey says. CSL is up 1.1% at A$194.35. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
